title: 川西大环线出发核对清单
prompt: 明天出发去川西大环线，需要准备什么？给我个核对清单
program:
root = Col([intro, tool, closing])

$done = []
$cat = "docs"

intro = Text("明天进入川西大环线，高海拔和长距离驾驶是主要风险。先逐项核对下面的清单；它按证件财务、衣物防晒、药品氧气和车辆工具分组，标注为“示例数据”的部分可自行增减。", "md", "muted")

tool = TravelModule([sampleNote, progress, controls, list, footer], "choices", "川西大环线 · 出发前核对清单", "明天出发 · 按证件、衣物、药品、车辆分类")

closing = Text("出发前再确认：沿途部分垭口海拔超过 4000 米，氧气瓶和防滑链不要放在后备箱最深处；如有降雪或道路管制，请按官方通行信息调整行程，勿因赶路冒险通行。", "sm", "muted")

sampleNote = Caption("示例数据，可自行增减")

progress = Col([Row([Text("核对进度", "sm"), Spacer(), Text(checkedTotal + "/" + total)], 2), progressBar, criticalText], 2)

controls = Col([SegmentedControl($cat, catOptions, true), Button("全部重置", @Reset($done), "ghost", "danger", "sm", "rotate-ccw", false, true)], 2)

list = Col(@Each(filteredRows, "i", Pressable([Row([Icon(i.checked ? "check-circle" : "circle", "sm", i.checked ? "success" : "muted"), Col([Text(i.label, "sm", i.checked ? "muted" : "ink", "normal", false, i.checked), i.note ? Caption(i.note) : null], 1), Spacer(), i.critical ? Badge("必备", "danger") : null], 2)], @Set($done, @Toggle($done, i.id)), i.checked, 2)), 1)

footer = Col([Divider(), Row([Icon("cloud-snow", "sm", "info"), Text("出发前查看沿途天气和道路通行公告，按实际路况准备防滑装备。", "xs", "muted")], 2), Row([Icon("clock", "sm", "info"), Text("出发时间请结合路况、天气与休息情况安排。", "xs", "muted")], 2)], 2)

rows = @Each(items, "i", {id: i.id, cat: i.cat, label: i.label, note: i.note, critical: i.critical, checked: @Includes($done, i.id)})

filteredRows = @Filter(rows, "cat", "==", $cat)
total = @Count(items)
checkedTotal = @Sum(@Each(rows, "r", r.checked ? 1 : 0))
criticalMissing = @Sum(@Each(rows, "r", (r.critical && !r.checked) ? 1 : 0))
progressPercent = @Round(@Percent(checkedTotal, total))

progressBar = Box([Box([], null, null, null, "success", "full", null, progressPercent + "%", 8)], null, null, null, "faint", "full", null, "100%", 8)

criticalText = Text(criticalMissing > 0 ? "必备项还有 " + criticalMissing + " 项未核对" : "必备项已全部核对", "sm", criticalMissing > 0 ? "warning" : "success")

catOptions = [{value: "docs", label: "证件财务"}, {value: "clothes", label: "衣物防晒"}, {value: "oxygen", label: "药品氧气"}, {value: "car", label: "车辆工具"}]

items = [
  {id: "idcard", cat: "docs", label: "身份证原件", note: "沿途住宿和检查站需要", critical: true},
  {id: "license", cat: "docs", label: "驾驶证、行驶证、保险单", note: "车辆手续随车备查", critical: true},
  {id: "cash", cat: "docs", label: "少量现金", note: "部分垭口信号弱，手机支付可能失败", critical: false},
  {id: "powerbank", cat: "docs", label: "充电宝与充电线", note: "低温下手机掉电更快", critical: false},
  {id: "jacket", cat: "clothes", label: "冲锋衣与羽绒内胆", note: "早晚温差大，垭口可能接近 0°C", critical: true},
  {id: "sun", cat: "clothes", label: "防晒帽、墨镜、防晒霜", note: "高原紫外线强", critical: true},
  {id: "gloves", cat: "clothes", label: "保暖手套与围巾", note: "凌晨和垭口体感更冷", critical: false},
  {id: "shoes", cat: "clothes", label: "防滑登山鞋", note: "部分观景台有碎石和薄冰", critical: false},
  {id: "rain", cat: "clothes", label: "雨衣或轻便雨伞", note: "山区天气变化快", critical: false},
  {id: "rhodiola", cat: "oxygen", label: "红景天或高原安", note: "如未提前服用，今天开始按说明", critical: true},
  {id: "oxygen", cat: "oxygen", label: "氧气瓶或氧气袋", note: "至少每人 1 瓶备用", critical: true},
  {id: "meds", cat: "oxygen", label: "布洛芬、感冒药、肠胃药", note: "高反头痛和饮食不适常见", critical: true},
  {id: "motion", cat: "oxygen", label: "晕车药与创可贴", note: "盘山路多，小外伤备用", critical: false},
  {id: "lipbalm", cat: "oxygen", label: "润唇膏与保湿乳", note: "高原干燥，嘴唇易裂", critical: false},
  {id: "chain", cat: "car", label: "防滑链", note: "折多山等垭口可能有雪", critical: true},
  {id: "spare", cat: "car", label: "备胎、千斤顶、拖车绳", note: "长距离非铺装路段备用", critical: true},
  {id: "fluid", cat: "car", label: "防冻玻璃水与防冻液", note: "低温地区必备", critical: false},
  {id: "offline", cat: "car", label: "离线地图与车载充电", note: "部分路段无信号", critical: false},
  {id: "check", cat: "car", label: "出发前车况检查", note: "刹车、胎压、灯光、油量", critical: true}
]
